body:
> **Status 2026-10-15: reopened. Not fixed.** Closed at 2026-10-15T12:14Z by the merge of #3295, which fixed only #3276 and part of #3174. Its description says "Part of #3174" and "Part of #3282", and warns the maintainer that the unreleased old link repair on production would append `Fixes` lines for the whole #3282 tree. It did (27 lines below the `---`), and the merge closed them all. That is #3174 again.

## Goal

For every issue Hive Mind takes, with any model (Anthropic, OpenAI or Formal AI) and any tool (`/claude`, `/codex`, `/agent`), the result is either:
- a **correct pull request**: new commits, green CI, every requirement delivered, ready for review; or
- an **honest failure**: reported as a failure in Telegram and on the issue or PR, with its real cause and the complete log attached, and with nothing closed that was not fixed.

This umbrella collects everything that still stops that. Each item below was checked against `main` at `d0084ee` (v2.35.10) on 2026-10-15. Production still runs 2.35.8, and the deploy is the maintainer's decision.

The same goal from the Formal AI side, with the motto "Don't know everything, know just enough to get to know anything", is link-assistant/formal-ai#651 → link-assistant/formal-ai#1162 / link-assistant/formal-ai#1212.

Tracked from formal-ai: this umbrella is a sub-issue of link-assistant/formal-ai#1162 (under link-assistant/formal-ai#651), so every critical issue for Formal AI pull-request delivery is reachable from one formal-ai issue.

## Critical blockers (sub-issues)

| Issue | What breaks delivery | State on main | Open PRs |
|---|---|---|---|
| #3215 | Formal AI Hello World through `/claude`, `/codex`, `/agent` | Hive Mind side merged in #3225; live run is #3277; follow-ups #3278 and #3279 | — |
| #3174 (+ #3276) | Link repair adds `Fixes` for sub-issues that were not implemented, including **issues in other repositories**; the merge closes them. On 2026-10-14 this closed 11 unfixed formal-ai issues. | #3276 (cross-repository) and the kept-open-by-description case were fixed by #3295 (merged 2026-10-15, **not released yet**: npm latest is 2.36.0). Still open: sub-issues created after the PR was opened, or already closed by another PR. | — |
| #2406 | Auto-merge does not require evidence that each requirement was delivered | open: only the link check of #2336 shipped | #2407 |
| #2303 | "✅ Work session finished successfully" after the session was OOM-killed (#3209 fixed unobserved sessions, not killed ones) | open | #2304 |
| #2293 | Auto-restart fires on an "issue description edited" event that did not happen | open | #2298 |
| #2889 | In-place kill recovery commits writable layers concurrently: ENOSPC, every recovery fails | open: no serialisation in `session-kill-resume.in-place.lib.mjs` | #2894, #2896, #3003 |
| #2888 | Fresh kill recovery cannot resume Codex threads (per-repository `CODEX_HOME` not mounted) | open | #2893 |
| #2891 | Kill-recovery notices posted to the parent plan PR instead of the PR being worked on | open: fallback to `sessionInfo.url` in `session-recovery-lifecycle.lib.mjs` | #2899 |
| #2887 | Kill recovery runs the Telegram alias as the program (exit 127) | **fixed in 2.35.10** by the #2630 commits `5577dc0` and `7e1d178` (not in 2.35.8, where it still recurred on 2026-10-14). Verify after deploy, then close. The alias parts of its PRs are then superseded (#2896 also covers #2889 and #2890). | #2895, #2896, #2918, #3127 |
| #2846 | `jq` missing in the task image: AI tools' `… \| jq` commands exit 127 | open: not in `Dockerfile.dind`. `command -v jq` is empty in the production `hive-mind` container too. | #2852 |
| #3330 | No-change Formal AI drafts are marked "ready for review (solution draft verified)" in CI: `gh api user` 403 under `GITHUB_TOKEN` makes the verdict unmeasured, and `dev/log/**` counts as changes | open (PR #3327, run 38728898890) | — |
| #3332 | E2E Hello World matrix can never pass: it tests GitHub Release v0.352.1 instead of the shipped 0.353.2, the default token rejects the required `.github/workflows/` file, and harness failures are not told apart from model failures | open: red on every run since 2026-10-13 (6 runs), 0 of 12 task PRs correct | — |
| #3354 | Linked issues are not always closed after a merge: GitHub missed 13 on default-branch merges, merges done outside Hive Mind never get the non-default-branch fallback, two of the three closing paths close only one issue, cross-repository references are blocked outright, and parents are never closed. Fix: close every *intended* issue, on by default, with `--no-auto-close-linked-issues` to switch it off | open: #3355–#3359 | — |
| #3176 | Repository mode selects bot-maintained status issues as work, which loops | open: `selectOldestOpenIssues` has no bot or label filter | #3179 |

## Related, not blocking (not sub-issues)

- #3333 attach the Formal AI server log to the session log (under link-assistant/formal-ai#1220) and #3334 the provenance verifier (under link-assistant/formal-ai#1213).

- #1355 / #756: one auto-restart engine and better restart comments. A refactor; the budget cap already exists.
- #2890: persist the solve queue across restarts. Queue loss does not damage a delivered PR.
- #2892: a daemon-restart kill is reported as OOM. A misclassification; live-restore is on now.
- #1629 and #1610: case-study tasks for old stuck or empty sessions.
- #3125: an auto-fix tracking instance for one OOM kill.

## Done when

- Every sub-issue is closed by a merged fix, and its open PRs are merged or closed as superseded.
- #3277 passes on production, and one issue per tool and model family (Anthropic, OpenAI, Formal AI) ends in a correct PR or an honest failure as defined above.

This is a tracking umbrella: solve its sub-issues one by one. Until #3174 is fixed, a single PR for this umbrella would add `Fixes` for every sub-issue, and its merge would close them all.
